finding: The Ads Transparency Center RPC rate-limits to HTTP 429 under sustained querying
observed: 2026-08-09 ~02:30 UTC, after roughly 500 SearchCreatives calls across 12 concurrent region agents plus a 62-domain sweep
error: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests (HTML interstitial, not JSON)
consequence: Any ATC negative gathered while 429s are firing is worthless. This is exactly why every sweep in this project runs a trezor.io positive control: a negative is only reportable when the control passed in the same run.
